'''Christian Alfred Elie Janot''' (January 4, 1936 – February 23, 2022) was a French physicist and materials scientist known for his work on [[Characterization (materials science)|materials characterization]] using [[Mössbauer spectroscopy]] and his [[physical metallurgy]] studies of [[quasicrystal]]s and noncrystalline materials using [[neutron scattering]] techniques.<ref name=JLI>{{Cite web |title=[Hommage] Christian Janot, ancien directeur du Laboratoire de Physique des Matériaux (LPM) {{!}} IJL |url=https://ijl.univ-lorraine.fr/article/hommage-christian-janot-ancien-directeur-du-laboratoire-de-physique-des-materiaux-lpm |access-date=2022-08-09 |website=ijl.univ-lorraine.fr}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Janot studied physics and mathematics at the [[University of Dijon]] and later joined Armand Hadni at [[University of Nancy]], where he received his PhD in 1963. Janot was one of the founding directors of the [[Jean Lamour Institute]], a joint research institute between [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]] and the [[University of Lorraine]]. Between 1982 and 1991, Janot was appointed senior scientist at [[Institut Laue Langevin]] in [[Grenoble]], France, and retained a long-term visitor position afterwards.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Christian Janot, IdRef : 028921100 |url=https://www.idref.fr/028921100}}</ref> During this period, Janot also became a professor at [[Joseph Fourier University]] (later part of [[Grenoble Alpes University]]).<ref>{{Cite web |title=ARILL - Association des retraités de l'Institut Laue-Langevin : Christian Janot |url=http://www.arill.fr/carnet-noir/christian-janot/ |access-date=2022-08-11 |website=www.arill.fr}}</ref>

Janot cowrote several textbooks in physics and materials science. [[Nobel Laureate]] [[Dan Shechtman]] wrote a foreword for his classic monograph<ref>{{Cite book |last=Janot |first=C |url=http://connection.ebscohost.com/c/articles/649116 |title=Quasicrystals: a primer |date=2012 |publisher=Clarendon Press; Oxford University Press |isbn=978-0-19-102179-4 |location=Oxford; New York |language=English |oclc=893707553}}</ref> on [[quasicrystal]]s.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=de Boissieu |first=M. |date=2014-05-01 |title=Quasicrystals. A Primer, second edition. By Christian Janot. Oxford Classic Texts in the Physical Sciences. Oxford University Press, 2012. Pp. 427. Price GBP 42.50 (paperback). ISBN 978-0-19-965740-7. |url=https://journals.iucr.org/a/issues/2014/03/00/pf0106/ |journal=Acta Crystallographica Section A: Foundations and Advances |language=en |volume=70 |issue=3 |pages=308 |doi=10.1107/S2053273314000266 |issn=2053-2733|doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
Janot was a French Government Overseas Fellow in 1981 at [[Churchill College, Cambridge|Churchill College]], [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=French Government Fellowship at Churchill College |url=https://www.chu.cam.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/Petite_Histoire_consolidated_-_8_July_14_2.pdf}}</ref> He was also a visiting professor at [[Sapienza University of Rome]].<ref name=JLI />
